title: 第五十九章 两位憋屈的冠军第五十八章 日常训练
content_zh:
“迷你龙，加油！”
对于迷你龙的训练林萧只能从体能开始，没办法小家伙的体能是弱项，绑上沙袋的迷你龙在草地上爬行需要费很大的劲才行。
林萧也为自己绑上沙袋陪迷你龙一起训练，增加两人的亲和度，顺便为迷你龙打气。在训练家的陪同下小精灵会发挥出远比平时要强的毅力。
“迷~~”尽管身上流满汗水，可迷你龙依旧努力向前爬，林萧的陪伴打气让它很开心。每一点点距离，迷你龙都要付出巨大的代价才能到达，就算如此迷你龙也不曾放弃，直到力气用尽晕厥在草地上。
抱着昏迷的迷你龙返回，林萧将它放在草地上，在它身上泼了点冷水，帮助它恢复体力，同时让芽衣帮迷你龙准备一些治疗疲劳的药物帮它缓解疲劳。
“林萧，会不会太残忍了，迷你龙还小。”芽衣的大眼中尽是不忍。
“这也是没有办法的事，”林萧擦下额头的汗水，喘息道：“想要获得强大的实力就必须吃很多苦，吃得苦中苦方为人上人嘛。”
“哎~”芽衣微微叹息一声，主人是这样，小精灵也是这样，干嘛都这么拼命？难道实力真那么重要？
彩虹市龙腾道馆中，希罗娜看着被黄色光圈包围趴在青龙雕像前的烈咬陆鲨，微微有些担心，烈咬陆鲨持续这样已经好几天了，而且期间米水不碰，宛如绝食一般。
在希罗娜身旁，渡轻声道：“放心吧，没事的，龙系小精灵一段时间不吃东西饿不死。”在希罗娜的烈咬陆鲨旁，渡的快龙同样不吃不喝的趴在那里，不过快龙身上的光圈是蓝色的和烈咬陆鲨不一样。
希罗娜翻了个白眼，我有说它会饿死？一开口就没好话，而且你的快龙还不是一样？
似乎察觉到了自己的话语不对，尴尬的打了个哈哈，“不过林萧的班吉拉本源领悟似乎越来越快了，真羡慕他小子，居然弄到一只资质这么好的小精灵。”比起班吉拉，烈咬陆鲨和快龙领悟自然本源的速度就慢了很多，和班吉拉不在同一水平线上。
希罗娜微微点头，同意渡的话，“早知道当初就想尽一切办法将林萧的由基拉换过来，母亲的资质这么好，孩子也不会差到哪去。”
“想不到神奥女冠军也有贪心的一面？”渡微微一笑：“还好林萧没有答应你，不过你认为这四大圣兽真的存在吗？”
说道这里渡的面色逐渐严肃起来，“快龙领悟本源，就算在家里的龙窟之中都没有任何反应，怎么在青龙的面前就会这样？难道四圣兽真的存在吗？如果是，那么它们的实力.....”
“我也不知道，”希罗娜微微摇头道：“我询问过，林萧说青龙是祖龙，龙族的老祖先，其他的就不肯多说了。不过这家伙真黑！一次领悟的机会就压榨了我一只小地龙！！！”
每次想到林萧不给小地龙就不告诉你领悟本源的方法的贪婪模样时，希罗娜都会恨得牙痒痒，真想在他脸上赏两个熊猫眼。
渡干咳一声，将头扭到一旁，这种待遇也在他身上发生，只不过将小地龙换成了迷你龙。
“叮铃铃！！”挑战者抽中7号签。
就在两人郁闷的时候，一旁的喇叭传出响声。

听到喇叭声希罗娜的脸顿时垮了下来，渡苦笑着摸着下巴，说道：“你去还是我去？”
能让两位冠军为自己守道馆，打发挑战者恐怕整个联盟也只有林萧才干得出来。
两位冠军大人虽然都很想甩手而却，可林萧敢把班吉拉放在道馆独自领悟本源他们不敢啊！烈咬陆鲨和快龙几乎是希罗娜和渡的命，根，子，要是期间出了问题两人还不哭死？
正是知道两位冠军不敢离开，林萧才安心的将班吉拉留在道馆，有两位冠军在，谁敢来打歪主意？
还没等两位冠军走到比赛场，训练室里就闹起来矛盾，无奈之下两人只好做起救火员。
训练室里，小明抱着笔记本，站在一旁，一位来自神奥的训练家，满口叫着：“不公平！”
“怎么回事？”希罗娜皱起眉头，强大的气场弥漫在训练室里，问道：“不知道，道馆里不准大声喧哗吗？”
希罗娜刚进来，这位大叫不公平的训练家立马哑火了，连任了三年冠军，在神奥无人能比，声望甚高。
如今偶像出现在自己身前，这位训练家激动的打抖！那还会抱怨龙腾道馆不公平的事。
和希罗娜、渡一起相处了十多天，小明已经对希罗娜的气场有了免疫力，耸耸肩膀把事情的经过说了出来。
原来这位挑战者，挑战失败之后介绍训练，发现自己没有和其他训练家一样有小精灵特别训练，至于大声喊冤，说联盟不公平，才会发生以上一幕。
又是林萧留下的烂摊子，希罗娜揉着泛疼的太阳穴，真想飞到林萧身边一把把他掐死！！这让自己怎么解释？关东地区的训练家有特别培训我神奥的没有？
令外一边渡的日子也不好过，挑战者是一位娇滴滴的小女孩，原本看到自己偶像渡还很兴奋。可挑战失败之后，一屁，股坐在地上耍起赖皮，“呜呜呜.....不公平！为什么道馆挑战会是冠军坐镇，这分明就是不想让我们得到徽章参加石英联盟，渡天王好讨厌！呜呜......”
小女孩哭闹让渡额头青筋直冒，论起战斗渡从来不虚谁，可谈起安慰哭泣中的小女孩这就要命了。还没谈过恋爱的渡哪会做这种事？真是上天无路，入地无门。
左哄右骗，好不容易把小女孩搞定，渡的后背已经被汗水打湿，没了冠军该有的气质，心里越想越不是个滋味，这不是纯属坑爹吗？
最终两位憋屈的冠军对林萧恨得咬牙切齿，发誓一定要把林萧大卸八块！做成腌肉喂狗！

content_en:
"Mini dragon, come on!"
Lin Xiao's training for the mini dragon can only start with physical fitness. There is no way that the little guy's physical fitness is a weak point. It takes a lot of effort for the mini dragon to crawl on the grass with a sandbag tied to it.
Lin Xiao also tied a sandbag on himself to train with the mini-dragon to increase the affinity between the two and cheer the mini-dragon up. Accompanied by a trainer, the elf will show far stronger perseverance than usual.
"Mysterious~~" Although the body was covered with sweat, the mini dragon still tried to crawl forward. Lin Xiao's companionship and encouragement made it very happy. The mini dragon had to pay a huge price to reach every little distance. Even so, the mini dragon never gave up until it ran out of strength and fainted on the grass.
Returning with the unconscious mini dragon in his arms, Lin Xiao placed it on the grass, poured some cold water on it to help it regain its strength, and asked Mei Yi to prepare some fatigue medicine for the mini dragon to relieve its fatigue.
"Lin Xiao, isn't that too cruel? The mini dragon is still young." Mei Yi's big eyes were full of unbearability.
"There is nothing we can do about it," Lin Xiao wiped the sweat from his forehead and gasped: "If you want to gain great strength, you have to endure a lot of hardships. Only by enduring hardships can you become a great person."
"Hey~" Yayi sighed slightly, the master is like this, and the elf is like this too, why are you working so hard? Is strength really that important?
In the Longteng Gym in Rainbow City, Sirona looked at Liebite Land Shark lying in front of the Azure Dragon statue surrounded by a yellow halo, and was slightly worried. Liebite Land Shark had been doing this for several days, and during this period, he did not touch rice or water, just like a hunger strike.
Next to Sirona, Du said softly: "Don't worry, it's okay. The dragon-type elf won't starve to death if he doesn't eat for a while." Next to Sirona's biting land shark, Du's Kuailong was also lying there without eating or drinking, but the aperture on the Kuailong's body was blue, which was different from the biting land shark.
Sirona rolled her eyes, did I say it would starve to death? There are no good things to say when you open your mouth, and your Kuailong is not the same?
He seemed to realize that his words were wrong, and he laughed awkwardly, "But Lin Xiao's understanding of the origin of Bangira seems to be getting faster and faster. I really envy him for getting an elf with such good qualifications." Compared with Bangira, Biting Land Shark and Kuailong's understanding of the origin of nature is much slower, and they are not on the same level as Bangira.
Sirona nodded slightly and agreed with Du's words, "If I had known, I would have tried every means to replace Lin Xiao's Yukila. If the mother's qualifications are so good, the child will not be any worse."
"I didn't expect that the Sinnoh female champion also has a greedy side?" Du smiled slightly: "Fortunately, Lin Xiao didn't agree to you, but do you think these four holy beasts really exist?"
Speaking of this, Du's face gradually became serious, "Kuailong understood the origin, and there was no reaction even in the dragon cave at home. How could it be like this in front of Qinglong? Do the four holy beasts really exist? If so, then their strength..."
"I don't know either," Sirona shook her head slightly and said, "I asked, and Lin Xiao said that Qinglong is the ancestral dragon, the ancestor of the dragon clan, and wouldn't say much else. But this guy is so dark! He squeezed a little earth dragon out of me with just one chance of understanding!!!"
Every time she thought of Lin Xiao's greed for not telling you the way to understand the origin without giving it to the little earth dragon, Sirona would itch with hatred and really wanted to give him two panda eyes on his face.
Du coughed and turned his head to the side. This kind of treatment also happened to him, except that the small earth dragon was replaced by a mini dragon.
"Ding bell bell!!" The challenger drew the No. 7 lottery.
Just when the two of them were depressed, a sound came from the speaker nearby.
Sirona's face suddenly fell when she heard the sound of the horn. Du smiled bitterly and touched his chin and said, "Are you going or should I go?"
To allow two champions to defend the gym for themselves, and to send away the challengers, I am afraid that the entire leagueOnly Lin Xiao can do this in the alliance.
Although the two champions wanted to give up and give up, they didn't dare to put Bangila in the gym to realize the origin alone! Biting Lu Shark and Kuailong is almost the fate of Sirona and Du. Gen, Zi, if something goes wrong during this period, won't they cry to death?
It was precisely because he knew that the two champions did not dare to leave that Lin Xiao left Bangila in the gym with peace of mind. With the two champions here, who would dare to mess up the idea?
Before the two champions could reach the competition field, a conflict broke out in the training room. In desperation, the two had to act as firefighters.
In the training room, Xiao Ming held his notebook and stood aside. A trainer from Sinnoh shouted: "Unfair!"
"What's going on?" Sirona frowned, a strong aura filled the training room, and asked, "I don't know, isn't it allowed to make loud noises in the gym?"
As soon as Sirona came in, the trainer who shouted unfairness immediately lost his temper. He had been the champion for three consecutive years. He was unrivaled in Sinnoh and had a high reputation.
Now that his idol appeared in front of him, the trainer was shaking with excitement! Then he would complain about the unfairness of Longteng Gym.
After spending more than ten days with Sirona and Du, Xiao Ming has become immune to Sirona's aura, shrugging his shoulders and telling what happened.
It turned out that this challenger, after failing the challenge, introduced the training and found that he did not have special elf training like other trainers. As for shouting injustice and saying that the alliance was unfair, the above scene happened.
It was Lin Xiao's mess again. Sirona rubbed her painful temples and really wanted to fly to Lin Xiao and strangle him to death! ! How do you explain this to yourself? Have the trainers in the Kanto region specially trained me in Sinnoh?
Life is not easy for Watanabe, and the challenger is a cute little girl. She was originally very excited to see her idol, Watanabe. But after the challenge failed, he sat down on the ground and started acting like a fool, "Woooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo ... ! Why does the gym challenge have the champion in charge? This is obviously because they don't want us to get badges to join the Quartz League. King Dutian is so annoying! Boo hoo..."
The little girl was crying, and veins were popping up on Du's forehead. When it came to fighting, Du was never in vain, but when it came to comforting the crying little girl, he would die. How could Du, who had never been in love before, do such a thing? There is really no way to heaven and no way to earth.
After coaxing and lying, Du's back was already wet with sweat, and he lost the temperament that a champion should have. The more he thought about it, the more uncomfortable he felt. Isn't this just a lie?
In the end, the two aggrieved champions gritted their teeth with hatred towards Lin Xiao and vowed to tear Lin Xiao into pieces! Make it into bacon and feed it to your dog!
